errors.evidence: The term "trade-offs" is an interpretation of the relationship between the plotted variables, not a direct description of the visual elements. The prompt requests objective features only.
The right y-axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)", has a visible range from 40 to 100, not 0 to 100.
The tick marks on the right y-axis are spaced every 10 units (40, 50, 60, etc.), not every 20 units.
The final value for the "Perplexity" line is approximately 4.38, not 4.4. Furthermore, the line drops from the previous point at 90% (~4.39), it does not rise.
The description of the "GPU Mem. Ratio" line as increasing "gradually" is an over-generalization. The line increases very steeply after the 80% mark on the x-axis.
The final value for the "GPU Mem. Ratio" line at 100% ratio is approximately 99%, not 95%.
